# guidance targets — `features/`

G03 features directory guidance.

## Project layout

    features/
    ├─ billing/ ❗                      billing (instance of [feature]/)
    │
    ├─ checkout/ ❗                     the checkout feature (instance of
    │                                   [feature]/)
    │
    ├─ orders/ ❗                       orders (instance of [feature]/)
    │
    └─ [feature]/ 0+                    one feature
       │
       ├─ steps/                        database steps
       │  │
       │  └─ [step=0000]_[t=a+].sql 0+  a step
       │
       ├─ {feature}.ts ❗               the entry file (instance of
       │                                [name=a+].ts, {feature} repeats what
       │                                [feature] matched)
       │
       └─ [name=a+].ts 0+               a module

❗ marks a named file or directory that must exist; one without it may be absent. A count after a pattern, such as `0+` or `1+`, is the fewest matching names that must exist.

In `[step=0000]`, the text after `=` is a mask: each character matches one character of the name. `0` matches a digit and `a` a lowercase letter. `+` repeats the element before it one or more times. `espalier help matching` has the full grammar.
